g.text: # Celebrity Radar — Shah Rukh Khan
Social Media & Rumors
Confirmed/official engagement and reactions:
Sep 15, 2026 — #AskSRK trended; media highlighted playful replies and his defense of director Siddharth
Anand amid queries about King teaser timing (Times of India).
Feb 2026 — King date announcement drove #ItsKingTime/#King chatter across platforms (official YouTube
announcement).
Nov 2–3, 2025 — Massive fan turnout for Khan’s birthday; clips of cake‑cutting and his signature pose
trended (#HappyBirthdaySRK, #SRKDay) (India Today).
Nov 2, 2025 — “King” first look sparked comparisons to Brad Pitt’s F1 styling; debate and memes trended
(Business Standard).
Ongoing — Coverage notes a deliberate teaser strategy for King designed to fuel intrigue without
revealing too much, sustaining speculation (THR India).
Unverified or debunked items (explicitly flagged as false/uncertain):
Sep 24, 2026 — Viral video claiming Khan “reprimanded Saudi Arabia” over a death‑penalty case debunked;
audio assessed as likely AI‑generated (CyberPeace).
Sep–Oct 2026 — Purported “leaked scene” from King circulated; fans and coverage labeled it likely
AI‑generated; unverified (Filmibeat).
Jun 18–26, 2026 — Viral deepfake falsely showing Khan endorsing an “AI money‑making” scheme was debunked
(DFRAC; other fact‑checks).
Jan 6, 2026 — Viral clip alleging a political comment by Khan flagged as AI‑generated (CyberPeace).
Feb 11, 2026 — Video suggesting he commented on Rajpal Yadav’s legal matter debunked as AI/miscaptioned
(CyberPeace).
Sentiment snapshot (last 12 months):
Polarized but strong engagement around King: ardent fan hype versus skepticism about tone/marketing;
discourse spikes around teaser delays and box‑office expectations (THR India; Times of India).
Note: No material conflicts between sources were identified in the above items.
